info.title: Liver Tumour Intelligence Platform API
info.description: REST API of the research platform. This platform is intended for academic research and software experimentation only. It has not been clinically validated and must not be used for diagnosis, treatment decisions or emergency medical decisions. Model outputs are experimental predictions and require independent clinical validation.
